vcs.page_description: Connect a self-hosted Forgejo, Gitea, or GitLab instance to mirror pull requests onto issues. Each connection uses an access token; agents push branches and open PRs using the runtime's own Git credentials.

vcs.webhook_setup_description: Add a webhook on your repository or organisation with the URL and secret below. Forgejo/Gitea: choose the Gitea format and the Pull Request (and Commit Status) events. GitLab: paste the secret as the token and enable Merge request and Pipeline events.

vcs.rotate_confirm_description: The current webhook secret will stop working immediately. Deliveries from your Git provider will fail until you update the webhook secret in provider settings.
